Bottle Information

Bottler: Distillery
Cask Type: sherry cask matured
Type: Single Malt Scotch
Volume: 70cl
Region: Highland
Age: 18 Year Old
ABV: 46.00%

Tasting Notes

Nose: Waves of dried fig, raisin syrup and dark honey mingle with orange peel, mocha, and a hint of cinnamon-dusted walnut. Palate: Silky folds of treacle toffee, dark chocolate and malt loaf coat the tongue, followed by clove-spiced praline, roasted hazelnut and a bright flash of candied citrus. Finish: Long, warming and elegantly dry—lingering sherry-soaked fruitcake, supple oak tannin and a final flourish of vanilla-malt sweetness.

Experience the pinnacle of GlenAllachie’s core range with GlenAllachie 18 Year Old. Hand-selected by Billy Walker, the whisky is built around long-matured spirit from 1st-fill Oloroso and Pedro Ximénez sherry puncheons, balanced with a parcel of well-seasoned American-oak barrels to retain bright orchard fruit. Bottled at 46 % ABV, non-chill-filtered and natural in colour, this expression delivers velvet richness, polished oak and layered complexity that only eighteen patient years can provide.

Why We Think You’ll Love It

  • Full sherry influence: Oloroso for nutty depth, PX for lush dark-fruit richness—balanced by subtle bourbon cask brightness.

  • Bottled at 46 % ABV, non-chill-filtered and natural colour for maximum texture, aroma and authenticity.

  • Combines GlenAllachie’s orchard-fruit DNA with decades-deep oak finesse—ideal for contemplative sipping.

  • A flawless showcase of Billy Walker’s cask-selection mastery and a benchmark for modern, mature Speyside single malts.

Pour a dram of GlenAllachie 18 Year Old and savour an exquisite harmony of honeyed fruit, sumptuous sherry and polished oak—an unforgettable Speyside indulgence that lingers long after the final sip.

The Distillery

Glenallachie
Glenallachie Distillery, located on the eastern edge of Ben Rinnes Mountain in Scotland’s prestigious Speyside whisky region, is renowned for its picturesque setting, often nestled within the snowline and exposed to the natural elements. Designed by architect William Delmé-Evans, the modern yet aesthetically pleasing distillery seamlessly blends contemporary architecture with the rugged beauty of its Highland surroundings. Commissioned in 1967 with two stills, Glenallachie expanded to four stills in 1989 to accommodate the growing demand for its distinctive Glenallachie malt whisky, a staple in many renowned whisky blends. While official distillery releases are limited, independent bottlers such as Signatory Vintage and Cadenheads offer a more extensive range of Glenallachie single malts, making them highly sought after by whisky enthusiasts and collectors. Glenallachie Distillery continues to uphold its reputation for quality and craftsmanship, contributing significantly to both single malt and blended Scotch whisky markets worldwide.
